newsitem.title: FRANCE: Four policemen injured in hold-up shooting.
newsitem.headline: Four policemen injured in hold-up shooting.

text.p: Four policemen were wounded, one seriously, when gangsters opened fire on their vehicle as it drove into a petrol station unaware that a hold-up was underway there, police said on Friday.
The gunmen, armed with pump shotguns, numbered at least six and got away with 25,000 francs ($4,500) during the attack outside this western French city late on Thursday.
